title: Tutor Learner Awareness
description: Equip the EthioBio tutor pipeline with per-learner awareness: a LearnerProfileBuilder converts a LearnerSnapshot into a structured profile block, and the TutorNode injects it into the system prompt so the LLM adapts its explanations to the student's ability, misconceptions, and weak areas.

userStories.title: LearnerProfileBuilder: snapshot-to-text function
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a pure function that takes a LearnerSnapshot (and optional current_topic) and returns a BuildProfileResult with difficulty_level, a formatted profile_block string, and known_misconceptions list.
acceptanceCriteria: LearnerProfileBuilder class with build_profile(snapshot: LearnerSnapshot, current_topic: str | None = None) -> BuildProfileResult
_determine_difficulty returns 'BEGINNER', 'DEVELOPING', 'PROFICIENT', or 'ADVANCED' based on confidence, ability_by_topic, mastery_by_topic severity, and weak_topics
BEGINNER when any critical severity OR confidence < 0.3 OR any ability < -1.0
DEVELOPING when any moderate severity OR 0.3 <= confidence < 0.6 OR any ability < 0.0
PROFICIENT when no weak topics AND confidence >= 0.6 AND all abilities >= 0.0
ADVANCED when no weak topics AND confidence > 0.9 AND all abilities > 1.0
_find_misconceptions returns misconceptions matching current_topic with frequency >= 2, empty if no current_topic
_format_profile_block includes weak/strong topics, difficulty level, confidence, ability estimates, and known misconceptions section when present
Profile block omits '## Known Misconception' section when no misconceptions found

userStories.title: TutorNode integrates learner profile block into system prompt
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the TutorNode to conditionally inject a pre-built learner profile block into the system prompt when the pipeline has enabled learner awareness.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentState gains learner_profile_block: str = '' and use_learner_awareness: bool = False fields
TutorNode.__call__ injects state.learner_profile_block into the system prompt when both the block is non-empty and use_learner_awareness is True
Profile block is appended after the base system prompt (SOCRATIC or normal) but before memory_context block
Profile block is NOT injected when use_learner_awareness is False, even if learner_profile_block is set
Profile block is NOT injected when learner_profile_block is empty, even if use_learner_awareness is True
Profile block works identically in both normal and Socratic modes
run_graph() accepts learner_profile_block parameter and forwards it to AgentState with use_learner_awareness auto-set to bool(learner_profile_block)
userStories.notes: 6 tests passing. TutorNode + AgentState + orchestrator integration. Files: src/graph/state.py, src/graph/nodes/tutor.py, src/graph/orchestrator.py
